helpers_sql:
-- Install once on PostgreSQL in a schema controlled by the application owner.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fdd;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.try_double(value text)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN trim(value)::double precision;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN RETURN NULL;
END;
$$;

-- Sensor sweep assessability (twin of pandas sensor_sweep_catalog). Long-form inputs are SI only:
-- each sample is assessed only when its declared unit matches the role's SI quantity. Any other
-- unit, or none, masks that sample; nothing is converted or guessed here.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.norm_unit(value text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(btrim(value), ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'));
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('ahu_sat', 'chw_return_t', 'chw_supply_sp', 'chw_supply_t',
      'cooling_coil_entering_temp', 'cooling_coil_leaving_temp', 'cooling_sp', 'cw_return_t',
      'cw_supply_t', 'heating_coil_entering_temp', 'heating_coil_leaving_temp', 'heating_sp',
      'hw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'mat', 'oa_t', 'preheat_leave_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'sat_sp',
      'vav_discharge_t', 'vav_inlet_t', 'web_oa_dp', 'web_oa_t', 'web_wb_t', 'zone_air_temp_sp', 'zone_t')
      THEN 'absolute_temperature'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('ma_h', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'sa_h', 'web_oa_h', 'zone_rh')
      THEN 'relative_humidity'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_dp', 'chw_dp_sp', 'duct_static', 'duct_static_sp') THEN 'air_pressure'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_flow', 'min_flow_sp', 'vav_total_flow', 'zone_airflow_sp', 'zone_flow') THEN 'volume_flow'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_power', 'electric_kw') THEN 'power'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('electric_kwh', 'kwh') THEN 'energy'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_amps', 'chiller_current') THEN 'electric_current'
    WHEN btrim(role) = 'zone_co2' THEN 'concentration'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_reset_request_sum', 'hw_reset_request_sum', 'static_reset_request') THEN 'count'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit text, quantity text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN unit IS NULL OR btrim(unit) = '' THEN false
    WHEN quantity = 'absolute_temperature' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('c', 'degc', 'celsius')
    WHEN quantity = 'relative_humidity' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pct', 'percent', 'percent0100', 'rh', 'percentrelativehumidity')
      OR position('%' IN unit) > 0
    WHEN quantity = 'air_pressure' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pa', 'pascal')
    WHEN quantity = 'volume_flow' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'ls'
    WHEN quantity = 'power' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kw'
    WHEN quantity = 'energy' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kwh'
    WHEN quantity = 'electric_current' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'a'
    WHEN quantity = 'concentration' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'ppm'
    WHEN quantity = 'count' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'count'
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) = '' THEN false
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%sp' THEN true
    WHEN position('setpoint' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('status' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%cmd' THEN true
    WHEN position('command' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'occmode' THEN true
    WHEN position('occupied' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('occupancy' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'loopenabled' THEN true
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role text, unit text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role) THEN false
    ELSE fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit, fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role))
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.mask_sweep_val(role text, unit text, val double precision)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE WHEN fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role, unit) THEN val ELSE NULL END;
$$;

FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while fan_cmd > 0.05.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    fan_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

VAV-1.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occ_mode is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occ_mode from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occ_mode exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference fan_cmd here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack fan_cmd; the rule is then → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_t < 21.111111111 OR zone_t > 23.888888889 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5
       AND occ_mode IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

ZONE-COMFORT-PCT.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- zone_comfort_pct.sql
-- Comfort is the share of eligible elapsed time inside the band, not a row count.
-- Band placeholders ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI and history zone_t are SI °C (metric pack).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t >= 20 AND zone_t <= 24.444444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS comfort_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

FAULT-ELAPSED-HOURS.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fault_elapsed_hours.sql — comfort fault elapsed rollup
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_t and ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI are °C.
-- Out-of-band zone temperature holds forward until the next sample.
-- Gaps longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS are unknown (not fault, not covered).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fault_samples,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

OAT-METEO.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): oa_t and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment web_oa_t (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.oa_t,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS double precision) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.oa_t IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > 1500
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - ref_oa_t) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL

    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat,
    sat_sp,
    COALESCE(clg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS clg_valve_pct,
    COALESCE(oa_damper_pct, 0.0) AS oa_damper_pct,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
        CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0

      THEN 0.0

    FROM base src
  ) stepped

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING

    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked

  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id

  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mat,
    rat,
    oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN fan_on = 1 AND mat IS NOT NULL AND rat IS NOT NULL AND oa_t IS NOT NULL
       AND ABS(rat - oa_t) > 1.222222
       AND ((mat - rat) / NULLIF(oa_t - rat, 0)) * 100.0 < 21
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)

  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id

  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized

  SELECT base_proof.*,

  SELECT equipment_id,

SV-STALE.sql:
-- SV-STALE (#1673): missing data. A sensor series is stale while it has no valid sample for longer than
-- STALE_AFTER_HOURS. This rule has no value test (a stuck value that is still polled is SV-FLATLINE) and no
-- run-proof gate (data monitoring does not depend on the motor).
--
-- Expected series: `sweep_series` lists every bound series the caller fetched successfully, with its requested
-- window [window_start, window_end). A bound series with no sample at all is therefore assessed (it faults for
-- the whole window beyond STALE_AFTER_HOURS). A series the caller could not fetch is not listed and is not
-- assessed. Callers that do not fill `sweep_series` get the series present in `sensor_history`, over the
-- equipment's observed window (first to last timestamp in history and sensor_history).
--
-- Per series, the window start, every valid sample and the window end split the window into intervals. An
-- interval longer than STALE_AFTER_SECONDS contributes (interval - STALE_AFTER_SECONDS) of fault time, starting
-- STALE_AFTER_SECONDS after its first point. covered_hours is the whole window.
WITH eq_window AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, MIN(epoch_seconds) AS start_epoch, MAX(epoch_seconds) AS end_epoch
  FROM (
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM history
    UNION ALL
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM sensor_history
    WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  ) observed
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
declared AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_start)) AS start_epoch, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_end)) AS end_epoch
  FROM sweep_series
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
observed_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
expected AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch, end_epoch FROM declared
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.equipment_id, o.series_id, o.sensor_role, w.start_epoch, w.end_epoch
  FROM observed_series o
  JOIN eq_window w ON w.equipment_id = o.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN declared d ON d.equipment_id = o.equipment_id AND d.series_id = o.series_id
  WHERE d.series_id IS NULL
),
points AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM expected e
  JOIN sensor_history s ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND s.series_id = e.series_id
  WHERE fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) >= e.start_epoch
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) <= e.end_epoch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, end_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
),
steps AS (
  SELECT points.*,
    LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS next_epoch
  FROM points
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds, next_epoch - epoch_seconds AS dt_seconds
  FROM steps
  WHERE next_epoch IS NOT NULL AND next_epoch > epoch_seconds
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch, 0 AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800 THEN 1800 ELSE dt_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch, 1 AS confirmed,
    dt_seconds - 1800 AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  WHERE dt_seconds > 1800
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN scored ON scored.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND scored.series_id = e.series_id
ORDER BY e.equipment_id, e.series_id;

-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds

  FROM proof_stream

  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),

  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- pid_hunt_1.sql — Suspected control-output hunting (rolling 1h metrics)
-- Matches pandas hunting_fault_mask: TV / span / cycles / reversals over
-- WINDOW_HOURS. The detection window is still a row frame (WINDOW_ROWS).
-- Fault hours integrate eligible forward deltas and do not add a phantom
-- interval after the last sample. 12 / 11
-- are derived from WINDOW_HOURS + POLL_SECONDS (literal ROWS bounds).
-- Inputs are fractions 0-1 (input_contract.sql); the control output is converted to percent points (x 100)
-- exactly here, once, because the *_PCT parameters (span, deadband, total variation) are percent points.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(run_proof) AS run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        oa_damper_pct * 100.0
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        clg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        htg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        damper_pct * 100.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS out_pct,
    LAG(
      CASE
        WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          oa_damper_pct * 100.0
        WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          clg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          htg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          damper_pct * 100.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_out,
    COALESCE(loop_enabled, 1.0) AS loop_on,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_out IS NULL OR out_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(out_pct - prev_out) >= 1 THEN out_pct - prev_out
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS sig_delta
  FROM h
),
steps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(sig_delta)
    END AS abs_step,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL OR sig_delta = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sig_delta * LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) < 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS reversal_event
  FROM deltas
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    out_pct,
    fan_on,
    loop_on,
    COUNT(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS n_samples,
    SUM(abs_step) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS tv,
    MAX(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - MIN(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS span,
    SUM(reversal_event) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS reversals
  FROM steps
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN loop_on IS NOT NULL AND loop_on <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN out_pct IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN n_samples < CAST(CEIL(12 * 80 / 100.0) AS INT) THEN 0
      WHEN span < 20 THEN 0
      WHEN tv < 500 THEN 0
      WHEN span <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (tv / (2.0 * NULLIF(span, 0))) < 2.5 THEN 0
      WHEN reversals < 4 THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM win
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc4_os_hunting.sql — PID hunting (operating-state oscillation), GL36 fault 4
-- ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the clock hour: count how many times the AHU *enters* each
-- operating state within the hour and flag the whole hour when any state is
-- entered more than DELTA_OS_MAX times.
-- Operating states: 1 = min OA / heating, 2 = economizer, 3 = mechanical cooling
-- (0 = fan off, not counted).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(run_proof) AS run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_damper_pct AS oa_d,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE fan_cmd
    END AS fan,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
modes AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', h.timestamp_utc) AS clock_hour,
    CASE
      WHEN fan IS NULL OR fan < 0.01 THEN 0
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg > 0.1 THEN 3
      WHEN oa_d IS NOT NULL AND oa_d > 0.5 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS op_mode,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rps.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proven
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
-- #1631: entries are counted over PROVEN samples only (the sequence skips unproven time, so a transition across
-- unproven time is not an entry and an unproven flap cannot reach the hourly count); pandas fc4 does the same.
entries AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    clock_hour,
    op_mode,
    CASE
      WHEN op_mode = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN op_mode <> LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_entry
  FROM modes
  WHERE proven = 1
),
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    clock_hour,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_min_oa,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_econ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_mech
  FROM entries
  GROUP BY equipment_id, clock_hour
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT
    m.equipment_id,
    m.timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_min_oa, 0) AS entries_min_oa,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_econ, 0) AS entries_econ,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_mech, 0) AS entries_mech
  FROM modes m
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON hc.equipment_id = m.equipment_id AND hc.clock_hour = m.clock_hour
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN entries_min_oa > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_econ > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_mech > 5 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM hourly
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

-- Proof (#1642, pandas mechanical_proof_mask / mech_cooling_run_mask): compressor or chiller operation, never a cooling
-- valve alone. Candidates in order: compressor_status, chiller_status, chiller_amps > MECH_AMPS_MIN (5 A), chiller_power > MECH_POWER_KW_MIN (1 kW). Per
-- equipment the first candidate that is ever on is the proof (else the first one bound, which stays off); with none bound
-- there is no proof and no fault. Web dry bulb: the equipment's web_oa_t, else the weather sidecar joined as-of (latest
-- sample at or before the row, at most WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS old, as pandas weather_on_grid). Never BAS oa_t.
WITH wx_web_oa_t AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc AS ref_ts, ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(web_oa_t) AS ref_val
    FROM weather
    WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY timestamp_utc
  ) wx_web_oa_t_points
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(h.web_oa_t, wx_web_oa_t.ref_val) AS web_oa_t,
    CASE WHEN h.compressor_status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.compressor_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN h.chiller_status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN h.chiller_amps IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.chiller_amps > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c3,
    CASE WHEN h.chiller_power IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.chiller_power > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c4
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN wx_web_oa_t
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts
   AND (wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts)
   AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts)) <= 1500
),
proof_pick AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(c1) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN MAX(c2) = 1 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(c3) = 1 THEN 3 WHEN MAX(c4) = 1 THEN 4
      WHEN COUNT(c1) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(c2) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(c3) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN COUNT(c4) > 0 THEN 4
      ELSE 0
    END AS proof_kind
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN h.web_oa_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN h.web_oa_t >= 15.555556 THEN 0
      WHEN pp.proof_kind = 1 AND h.c1 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN pp.proof_kind = 2 AND h.c2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN pp.proof_kind = 3 AND h.c3 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN pp.proof_kind = 4 AND h.c4 = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
  JOIN proof_pick pp ON pp.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),

  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc

    FROM base src
  ) stepped

  SELECT
    *,

      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked

WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    chw_supply_t,
    chw_reset_request_sum,
    pump_status,
    chiller_status,
    chw_flow,
    chw_pump_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_flow > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

      ELSE NULL

  FROM history

base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,

      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on = 0 THEN 0

  FROM lagged
),

  SELECT
    *,

      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed

    equipment_id,

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sched247_always_on.sql — Always-on fan or pump runtime (#1670)
-- Unit-free: ALWAYS_ON_PCT is a fraction of proven run time.
--
-- Proof per sample: the first non-NULL status (fan, pump, chw pump, chiller, compressor, chiller current) wins over
-- the commands (tower fan, fan, chw pump); run when > 0.05 (sql/fdd/run_proof.json threshold); a sample with
-- neither is UNKNOWN (never a proven OFF). Each sample holds forward to the next one; a hold longer than
-- MAX_GAP_HOURS, and the last sample, hold nothing.
--
-- Durations (hours): window = first..last history row of the equipment (the observed window);
-- proven_on / proven_off = held time with known proof; unknown = window - proven_on - proven_off.
-- Completeness: the verdict needs proven time >= 0.9 * max(window, 24 h). "Always on" is judged on the
-- observed window but never on less than one day of proof. Otherwise assessment = 'insufficient_proof'
-- (or 'no_proof' when nothing is known) and fault_hours / fault_pct are NULL.
-- Qualifier: proven_on / (proven_on + proven_off) >= ALWAYS_ON_PCT (time-weighted). Fault time is the
-- confirmed proven-ON time (CONFIRM_SECONDS streaks) of a qualifying equipment.
WITH proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN compressor_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN compressor_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_current IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_current > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN tower_fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN tower_fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS INT) AS on_bit
  FROM history
),
stepped AS (
  SELECT
    proof.*,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM proof
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) OR on_bit IS NULL
      THEN 0.0 ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gap_after
  FROM stepped
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp_utc) - MIN(timestamp_utc))) AS window_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS on_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 0 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS off_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
verdict AS (
  SELECT
    summary.*,
    CASE
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds <= 0.0 THEN 'no_proof'
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds < 0.9 * (CASE WHEN window_seconds > 86400.0 THEN window_seconds ELSE 86400.0 END)
        THEN 'insufficient_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM summary
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.held_seconds,
    h.gap_after,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
       AND v.on_seconds / (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) >= 0.95
       AND h.on_bit = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM held h
  JOIN verdict v ON v.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM base
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  v.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed' THEN t.fault_seconds / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
    THEN 100.0 * t.fault_seconds / NULLIF(v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds, 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  v.window_seconds / 3600.0 AS window_hours,
  v.on_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_on_hours,
  v.off_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_off_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds > 0.0
    THEN (v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS unknown_hours,
  v.assessment
FROM verdict v
JOIN (
  SELECT equipment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_seconds
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) t ON t.equipment_id = v.equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-DEADBAND — pass-through FCU setpoints remain site-native Celsius.
-- Duration is the eligible forward delta, not a row count times poll.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

FCU-MODE-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-MODE-CYCLE — cumulative heat/cool mode transitions in the analysis window.
-- Hours are eligible forward deltas after the change count reaches MODE_CHANGES.
-- #1642: each sample holds the time to the NEXT sample of any mode (forward sample-and-hold); the change count runs
-- over the heating / cooling samples only. An idle sample is never fault time, and an active sample no longer holds
-- the idle stretch after it (it used to own the gap to the next active sample), as pandas fcu_mode_cycle.
WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND clg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN -1
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND htg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM modes
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed
  FROM held
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;

UTIL-MONTHLY.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_monthly_fault.sql — BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh; UTIL_PCT_ERR is a percent of utility kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timestamp_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > 10
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM joined;
UTIL-MONTHLY.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_interval_fault.sql — BAS 15m vs utility interval (rolling MAE proxy)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh (canonical interval_energy); UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE is kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > 5 THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM agg;

COIL-PERF.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- coil_perf.sql — Generic coil performance (#1641): a heating or cooling coil commanded open does not change the air
-- temperature by MIN_DT. One rule for any coil-bearing equipment, applied by bound roles (never by equipment names).
--
-- Mode per sample:
--   heating: heating valve (htg_valve_pct, else reheat_valve_pct) >= VALVE_OPEN and the cooling valve, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
--   cooling: cooling valve >= VALVE_OPEN and the heating / reheat valves, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
-- Temperature pair, the first complete one in this order (entering -> leaving):
--   1. dedicated coil sensors (heating_coil_entering_temp / _leaving_temp, cooling_coil_entering_temp / _leaving_temp)
--   2. air handler: mat -> sat
--   3. VAV reheat: vav_inlet_t -> vav_discharge_t
--   4. fan coil / zone: zone_t -> sat
-- Fault: heating and (leave - enter) < MIN_DT, or cooling and (enter - leave) < MIN_DT, with the fan on (fan_status, else
-- fan_cmd) and, where zone_flow is bound, airflow above FLOW_ON_MIN.
-- No coil valve or no temperature pair on any sample -> assessment 'no_coil_valve' / 'no_temperature_pair':
-- fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass). Run-proof gated like the other air-side rules (#1608).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(htg_valve_pct, reheat_valve_pct) AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    htg_valve_pct,
    reheat_valve_pct,
    zone_flow,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_leaving_temp - heating_coil_entering_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN sat - mat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_discharge_t - vav_inlet_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN sat - zone_t
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_entering_temp - cooling_coil_leaving_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN mat - sat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_inlet_t - vav_discharge_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN zone_t - sat
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  -- not assessable: no coil valve with data, or no complete temperature pair (reported, never a silent pass)
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN zone_flow IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow <= 11.798675 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= 0.8 AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= 0.05)
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < 3 THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= 0.8
       AND (htg_valve_pct IS NULL OR htg_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND (reheat_valve_pct IS NULL OR reheat_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
                     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  (SELECT px.assessment FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(htg_valve_pct, reheat_valve_pct) AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    htg_valve_pct,
    reheat_valve_pct,
    zone_flow,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_leaving_temp - heating_coil_entering_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN sat - mat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_discharge_t - vav_inlet_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN sat - zone_t
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_leaving_temp IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_entering_temp IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_entering_temp - cooling_coil_leaving_temp
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND mat IS NOT NULL THEN mat - sat
      WHEN vav_discharge_t IS NOT NULL AND vav_inlet_t IS NOT NULL THEN vav_inlet_t - vav_discharge_t
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL THEN zone_t - sat
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN zone_flow IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow <= 11.798675 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= 0.8 AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= 0.05)
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < 3 THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= 0.8
       AND (htg_valve_pct IS NULL OR htg_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND (reheat_valve_pct IS NULL OR reheat_valve_pct <= 0.05)
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

SHORT-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- short_cycle.sql — Boiler / compressor short cycling (#1781): too many starts in the trailing hour, or repeated
-- on-times shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS, read from proven run status (never a command).
--
-- Proof, the first candidate that is ever on (> 0.05), else the first one bound: boiler_status, compressor_status,
-- chiller_status, chiller_amps > MECH_AMPS_MIN, chiller_power > MECH_POWER_KW_MIN. None bound -> assessment
-- 'no_run_status': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass).
--
-- Duty-aware: a status sample is the on-fraction of its interval (NF resamples a 0/1 status by AVERAGE, so a bucket
-- holds a duty, never a max). Duty <= 0.05 is off, >= 0.95 is on for the whole interval, anything between is a
-- partial sample that must hold a start or a stop. Starts are the FEWEST consistent with the duties: one on-period
-- (cycle) spans whole-on samples and can begin or end only inside a partial sample, so in a run of non-off samples a
-- partial sample closes the cycle that is already open and the next sample opens a new one. A cycle's start counts
-- when it is seen (an off sample before it, or a stop inside the run); its on-time is the duty-weighted held time.
-- A completed cycle (start and stop both seen) shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS is a short cycle.
--
-- A sample is in fault when, over the trailing hour (t - 3600 s, t], starts > MAX_STARTS_PER_HOUR or short cycles
-- >= MIN_SHORT_CYCLES. No confirmation delay: the counts already span the hour. On a trend coarser than
-- MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS the counts are floors: a sample whose hour holds such an interval is fault time when the
-- floor reaches the threshold (assessment 'coarse_floor'), and otherwise unknown (not covered). Nothing covered ->
-- 'insufficient_trend' (NOT ASSESSED).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_s,
    boiler_status AS c1,
    compressor_status AS c2,
    chiller_status AS c3,
    CASE WHEN chiller_amps IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_amps > 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c4,
    CASE WHEN chiller_power IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_power > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c5
  FROM history
),
pick AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(c1) > 0.05 THEN 1 WHEN MAX(c2) > 0.05 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(c3) > 0.05 THEN 3
      WHEN MAX(c4) > 0.05 THEN 4 WHEN MAX(c5) > 0.05 THEN 5
      WHEN COUNT(c1) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(c2) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(c3) > 0 THEN 3
      WHEN COUNT(c4) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COUNT(c5) > 0 THEN 5
      ELSE 0
    END AS proof_kind
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
proof AS (
  SELECT h.equipment_id, h.timestamp_utc, h.epoch_s,
    CASE p.proof_kind WHEN 1 THEN h.c1 WHEN 2 THEN h.c2 WHEN 3 THEN h.c3 WHEN 4 THEN h.c4 WHEN 5 THEN h.c5 ELSE NULL END AS v
  FROM h
  JOIN pick p ON p.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
nb AS (
  -- valid proof samples only; neighbours are the previous / next valid sample
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    epoch_s,
    CASE WHEN v < 0.0 THEN 0.0 WHEN v >= 1.0 THEN 1.0 ELSE v END AS u,
    CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cls,
    LAG(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS prev_cls,
    LEAD(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS next_cls,
    epoch_s - LAG(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS dt_back,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_fwd
  FROM proof
  WHERE v IS NOT NULL
),
runs AS (
  SELECT
    nb.*,
    -- a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS breaks the sequence: nothing is known across it
    CASE WHEN dt_back IS NULL OR dt_back > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brk,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > 0.0 AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 THEN dt_fwd ELSE 0.0 END AS held_s,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 AND next_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS off_next,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > 900 AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS coarse
  FROM nb
),
pos AS (
  -- non-off samples; a run is a sequence of them with no off sample and no gap
  SELECT
    runs.*,
    CASE WHEN brk = 1 OR prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_start,
    CASE WHEN brk = 0 AND prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS seen_rise,
    CASE WHEN cls = 1 AND (brk = 1 OR prev_cls <> 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS chain_start
  FROM runs
  WHERE cls > 0
),
chains AS (
  SELECT
    pos.*,
    SUM(chain_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS chain_id
  FROM pos
),
chain_pos AS (
  -- k: position of a partial sample in its chain of consecutive partial samples
  SELECT
    chains.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id, cls ORDER BY epoch_s) - 1 AS k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN chain_start = 1 THEN run_start ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id) AS chain_at_run_start
  FROM chains
),
closing AS (
  -- a partial sample closes the open cycle unless it opened that cycle itself
  SELECT
    chain_pos.*,
    CASE
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 1 AND k % 2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 0 AND k % 2 = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS closes
  FROM chain_pos
),
opens AS (
  SELECT
    closing.*,
    CASE
      WHEN run_start = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN LAG(closes) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cycle_start
  FROM closing
),
cycles AS (
  SELECT
    opens.*,
    CASE WHEN cycle_start = 1 AND (run_start = 0 OR seen_rise = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_evt,
    SUM(cycle_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cycle_id
  FROM opens
),
cycle_sum AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    MAX(timestamp_utc) AS end_ts,
    MAX(start_evt) AS seen_start,
    MAX(CASE WHEN closes = 1 OR off_next = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_stop,
    SUM(u * held_s) AS on_s
  FROM cycles
  GROUP BY equipment_id, cycle_id
),
ev AS (
  SELECT
    r.equipment_id,
    r.timestamp_utc,
    r.epoch_s,
    r.coarse,
    COALESCE(c.start_evt, 0) AS start_evt,
    CASE WHEN s.equipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS short_evt
  FROM runs r
  LEFT JOIN cycles c
    ON c.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND c.timestamp_utc = r.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN cycle_sum s
    ON s.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND s.end_ts = r.timestamp_utc
   AND s.seen_start = 1 AND s.seen_stop = 1 AND s.on_s < 600
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(start_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS starts_h,
    SUM(short_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS short_h,
    MAX(coarse) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS coarse_h
  FROM ev
),
judged AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    coarse_h,
    CASE WHEN starts_h > 6 OR short_h >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
held AS (
  -- forward sample-and-hold over every history row (the last row and a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS hold nothing)
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_seconds
  FROM h
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    hd.equipment_id,
    hd.timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN j.equipment_id IS NULL THEN 0.0
      WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 0 THEN 0.0
      WHEN hd.dt_seconds IS NULL OR hd.dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR hd.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 0.0
      ELSE hd.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    COALESCE(j.raw_fault, 0) AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS floor_fault
  FROM held hd
  LEFT JOIN judged j
    ON j.equipment_id = hd.equipment_id AND j.timestamp_utc = hd.timestamp_utc
)
SELECT
  p.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(a.fault_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(a.covered_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(100.0 * a.fault_s / a.covered_s AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 THEN 'no_run_status'
    WHEN COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 'insufficient_trend'
    WHEN a.floor_fault = 1 THEN 'coarse_floor'
    ELSE 'assessed'
  END AS assessment
FROM pick p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_s,
    SUM(held_seconds) AS covered_s,
    MAX(CASE WHEN floor_fault = 1 AND held_seconds > 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS floor_fault
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) a ON a.equipment_id = p.equipment_id;

    CASE WHEN brk = 0 AND prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS seen_rise,
    CASE WHEN cls = 1 AND (brk = 1 OR prev_cls <> 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS chain_start
  FROM runs

    CASE WHEN s.equipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS short_evt
  FROM runs r
  LEFT JOIN cycles c
    ON c.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND c.timestamp_utc = r.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN cycle_sum s
    ON s.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND s.end_ts = r.timestamp_utc
   AND s.seen_start = 1 AND s.seen_stop = 1 AND s.on_s < 600
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(start_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS starts_h,
    SUM(short_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS short_h,
    MAX(coarse) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS coarse_h
  FROM ev
),
judged AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    coarse_h,
    CASE WHEN starts_h > 6 OR short_h >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_seconds
  FROM h
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    hd.equipment_id,
    hd.timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN j.equipment_id IS NULL THEN 0.0
      WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 0 THEN 0.0
      WHEN hd.dt_seconds IS NULL OR hd.dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR hd.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 0.0

    CASE WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS floor_fault
  FROM held hd
  LEFT JOIN judged j
    ON j.equipment_id = hd.equipment_id AND j.timestamp_utc = hd.timestamp_utc
)
