SV-RANGE.sql:
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static', 'chw_flow', 'chw_dp', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t', 'chiller_power')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static', 'chw_flow', 'chw_dp', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t', 'chiller_power')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static', 'chw_flow', 'chw_dp', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t', 'chiller_power')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((energized = 1 AND (__OFDD_SV_RANGE_BANDS__))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  -- #1673: time beyond MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS of a gap is unknown here (not covered, not a fault); SV-STALE scores gaps.
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) END AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;

    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),

  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized

    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,

    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,

  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')

-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times

  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged

proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized

  WHERE stream_kind = 1

sensor_rows AS (

    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,

    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')

prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch

),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment

valid AS (

),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_epoch,
    MIN(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_min,

    FIRST_VALUE(previous_value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_value,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_epoch
  FROM valid
),
segments0 AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment) AS segment_start_epoch
  FROM windowed
),
elapsed_window AS (
  SELECT segments0.*,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value < window_min

    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value > window_max

  FROM segments0
),
signals AS (
  SELECT elapsed_window.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,

),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0

  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,

scored AS (

         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,

  FROM elapsed_window
),
segments AS (

    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds

         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds

lagged AS (

  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (

  FROM lagged segments

  FROM streaks

final AS (

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Sensor-series input and output are keyed by the bound point UUID, not the role.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > __OFDD_SV_RATE_THRESHOLD__ THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 AND energized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed,
    held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE held_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) END AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while fan_cmd > 0.05.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    fan_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occ_mode is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occ_mode from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occ_mode exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference fan_cmd here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack fan_cmd; the rule is then → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_t < {{ZONE_T_LO}} OR zone_t > {{ZONE_T_HI}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_OCCUPIED}} >= 0.5
       AND occ_mode IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav2_night_setback.sql — unoccupied zone stays above heating setback
-- Occupied hours do not latch. Missing occ_mode → no unoccupied proof (no fault).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN occ_mode IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN (
        LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
          ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','0','0.0','no')
        OR (
          fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
          AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
        )
      )
       AND zone_t IS NOT NULL AND zone_t > {{SETBACK_HI}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM h src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING

  FROM grp
),

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed

  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,

OAT-METEO.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): oa_t and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment web_oa_t (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.oa_t,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS double precision) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.oa_t IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > {{WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS}}
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - ref_oa_t) > {{OAT_ERR}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 1
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
       AND COALESCE(LAG(assessable) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), false)
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN assessable AND raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sat_high_fault.sql — FC13 SAT above SP at full cooling + confirm (matches cookbook fc13)
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat,
    sat_sp,
    COALESCE(clg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS clg_valve_pct,
    COALESCE(oa_damper_pct, 0.0) AS oa_damper_pct,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
        CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > {{FAN_ON_MIN}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND sat_sp IS NOT NULL
       AND clg_valve_pct > {{CLG_FULL_MIN}}
       AND sat > sat_sp + {{EPS_SAT}}
       AND (oa_damper_pct <= {{OA_DAMPER_ECON_LOW}} OR oa_damper_pct > {{ECON_FULL_OPEN}})
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h

  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.

        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h

)
SELECT

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc2_mat_low.sql — FC2 mixed air below envelope + confirm (600s default)
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    run_proof,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mat,
    oa_t,
    rat,
    COALESCE(COALESCE(fan_cmd, 0.0), 0.0) AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > {{FAN_ON_MIN}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(run_proof, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mat IS NOT NULL AND oa_t IS NOT NULL AND rat IS NOT NULL
       AND (mat + {{EPS_MAT}}) < (CASE WHEN rat < oa_t THEN rat - {{EPS_RAT}} ELSE oa_t - {{EPS_OAT}} END)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

WITH rp AS (

  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static', 'chw_flow', 'chw_dp', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t', 'chiller_power')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.

  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static', 'chw_flow', 'chw_dp', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t', 'chiller_power')
),

  FROM sample_times

  FROM proof_stream
),

  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,

  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs

  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_epoch,
    MIN(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_min,
    MAX(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_max,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_value,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_epoch
  FROM valid
),
segments0 AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment) AS segment_start_epoch
  FROM windowed
),
elapsed_window AS (
  SELECT segments0.*,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}}
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}}
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value < window_min
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_min END AS elapsed_window_min,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}}
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}}
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value > window_max
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_max END AS elapsed_window_max
  FROM segments0
),
signals AS (
  SELECT elapsed_window.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((segment_start_epoch <= epoch_seconds - {{FLATLINE_SECONDS}}) AND (elapsed_window_max - elapsed_window_min <= __OFDD_SV_FLATLINE_TOL__) AND energized = 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM elapsed_window
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}}
         THEN dt_seconds - {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  -- #1673: time beyond MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS of a gap is unknown here (not covered, not a fault); SV-STALE scores gaps.
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role

  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END END AS fault_hours,

FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;

    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  -- #1673: time beyond MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS of a gap is unknown here (not covered, not a fault); SV-STALE scores gaps.
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) END AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'duct_static', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'duct_static', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'duct_static', 'cw_supply_t', 'cw_return_t')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((({{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 OR (energized = 1 AND coverage_pct >= {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}})) AND (__OFDD_SV_SPIKE_BANDS__))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}}
         THEN dt_seconds - {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 AND equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

SV-STALE.sql:
-- SV-STALE (#1673): missing data. A sensor series is stale while it has no valid sample for longer than
-- STALE_AFTER_HOURS. This rule has no value test (a stuck value that is still polled is SV-FLATLINE) and no
-- run-proof gate (data monitoring does not depend on the motor).
--
-- Expected series: `sweep_series` lists every bound series the caller fetched successfully, with its requested
-- window [window_start, window_end). A bound series with no sample at all is therefore assessed (it faults for
-- the whole window beyond STALE_AFTER_HOURS). A series the caller could not fetch is not listed and is not
-- assessed. Callers that do not fill `sweep_series` get the series present in `sensor_history`, over the
-- equipment's observed window (first to last timestamp in history and sensor_history).
--
-- Per series, the window start, every valid sample and the window end split the window into intervals. An
-- interval longer than STALE_AFTER_SECONDS contributes (interval - STALE_AFTER_SECONDS) of fault time, starting
-- STALE_AFTER_SECONDS after its first point. covered_hours is the whole window.
WITH eq_window AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, MIN(epoch_seconds) AS start_epoch, MAX(epoch_seconds) AS end_epoch
  FROM (
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM history
    UNION ALL
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM sensor_history
    WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  ) observed
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
declared AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_start)) AS start_epoch, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_end)) AS end_epoch
  FROM sweep_series
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
observed_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
expected AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch, end_epoch FROM declared
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.equipment_id, o.series_id, o.sensor_role, w.start_epoch, w.end_epoch
  FROM observed_series o
  JOIN eq_window w ON w.equipment_id = o.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN declared d ON d.equipment_id = o.equipment_id AND d.series_id = o.series_id
  WHERE d.series_id IS NULL
),
points AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM expected e
  JOIN sensor_history s ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND s.series_id = e.series_id
  WHERE fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) >= e.start_epoch
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) <= e.end_epoch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, end_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
),
steps AS (
  SELECT points.*,
    LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS next_epoch
  FROM points
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds, next_epoch - epoch_seconds AS dt_seconds
  FROM steps
  WHERE next_epoch IS NOT NULL AND next_epoch > epoch_seconds
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch, 0 AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} THEN {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} ELSE dt_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds + {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} AS segment_epoch, 1 AS confirmed,
    dt_seconds - {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  WHERE dt_seconds > {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}}
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN scored ON scored.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND scored.series_id = e.series_id
ORDER BY e.equipment_id, e.series_id;

SV-RATE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Sensor-series input and output are keyed by the bound point UUID, not the role.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role run_proof is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(run_proof) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.run_proof > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0

  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),

    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
